description: This file defines an enumeration `PsMsgId` within the `PdfSharp.Internal` namespace that represents message IDs for error and diagnostic messages generated by the PDFsharp library. It categorizes message IDs for general, XGraphics, PDF, and PDF parser related messages.

classes.name: PsMsgId
classes.description: An enum defining various message identifiers used for error and diagnostic messages within PDFsharp.
